paragraphs.text: Sokenzanshi is a city located among the Sokenzan mountains in Kamigawa .

Sokenzanshi is the industrial heart of Kamigawa's empire . The hardy, self-reliant city of Sokenzanshi is home to a thriving community of independent artisans and tinkerers. Foundries and ironworks are built right into the sides of the mountains to shelter from frequent snowstorms and tap straight into the fires at the mountain's heart. Life in the mountain city isn't the easiest, and those who call the city their home are stubborn, resourceful, and fiercely committed to their way of life. The city surrounds a frozen river. Natural mineral hot springs dot the city's surrounding slopes and are a year-round attraction.
The city is the main base of the Asari Uprisers .
In Kamigawa: A Visual Novel , Sokenzanshi is spelled "Sokenzan-shi", implying this may have been the city's original name.
